types.name: List
types.port_note: Native pointers yield the required 8-byte Xbox layout.

types.name: _graph_entry
types.port_note: Fixed-width 32-bit fields preserve Microsoft long layout.

types.name: MemoryPool
types.port_note: The pointer shrinks on Xbox; fixed-width fields yield a 20-byte target layout.

types.name: VECTOR
types.port_note: Fixed-width 32-bit fields preserve Microsoft long layout.

types.name: _sfvector
types.port_note: Natural float alignment preserves the two trailing padding bytes.

types.name: MATRIX
types.port_note: Fixed-width translation fields preserve Microsoft long layout.

types.name: Camera
types.port_note: The pointer-free fixed-width record is 76 bytes on both PC and Xbox.

types.name: sceneGeometryEnv
types.port_note: All members are fixed-width math records; the layout is 176 bytes on PC and Xbox.

types.name: PADLOAD
types.port_note: Fixed-width pad masks preserve the eight-byte PC/Xbox record.

types.name: Plane
types.port_note: VECTOR plus an explicit 32-bit constant preserves the PDB layout.

types.name: wapChunk
types.port_note: Fixed-width fields preserve the 16-byte archive header on PC and Xbox.

types.name: rdVECTOR
types.port_note: Fixed-width fields preserve Microsoft long layout.

types.name: BAP_AI
types.port_note: pVars is a 32-bit pointer-registry index, not a host pointer.

types.name: wsl_ENEMY
types.port_note: Native AI/player/kung-fu links preserve the matched x64 layout and compact on 32-bit Xbox.

types.name: wsl_libPart
types.port_note: The PC archive is patched in place with its x64 header; Xbox-ready assets must convert this pointer-bearing header to the asserted 32-bit runtime form.

types.name: _BINHEADER
types.port_note: Files serialize only NumMats material entries before the name table; the full PDB type records the 1024-entry stack capacity used by InitJPX.

types.name: objectRoot
types.port_note: Native pParent preserves the 24-byte x64 layout and compacts objectRoot to 20 bytes on 32-bit Xbox.

types.name: playerObject
types.port_note: All pointer-bearing fields use native pointers. The exact x64 offsets are asserted; the runtime-only record intentionally compacts on 32-bit Xbox rather than copying the remaster ABI.

types.name: _jheightstuff
types.port_note: Native pointers preserve the x64 PDB layout and compact this runtime query record on 32-bit Xbox.

types.name: sceneObject
types.port_note: All component links are native objectRoot pointers; exact x64 offsets are asserted and the runtime record compacts on 32-bit Xbox.

types.name: _solid
types.port_note: Native object and geometry pointers preserve the x64 PDB layout and intentionally compact the runtime collision record on 32-bit Xbox.

types.name: _collidevars
types.port_note: Native FVECTOR pointers preserve the x64 PDB layout and compact the scratch record on 32-bit Xbox.

types.name: physicsObject
types.port_note: Exact x64 offsets are asserted. Native subsystem, collision, and map-query pointers intentionally compact the runtime-only record on 32-bit Xbox.

types.name: Motion
types.port_note: Pointer-free record has an identical 100-byte representation on PC and Xbox.

types.name: _animFrame
types.port_note: Pointer-free frame has an identical 560-byte representation on PC and Xbox; the PDB arrays are 256 bytes each, or 32 eight-byte vectors.

types.name: _animTemplate
types.port_note: Pointer-free template has an identical 32-byte representation on PC and Xbox.

types.name: _dpcontext
types.port_note: Native stream pointers preserve the exact x64 PDB layout and compact for the 32-bit Xbox runtime.

types.name: animListNode
types.port_note: Native intrusive-list and payload pointers preserve the exact x64 PDB layout and compact for Xbox.

types.name: animObject
types.port_note: Exact x64 offsets are asserted. Native pointers and lists intentionally compact the runtime-only animation record on 32-bit Xbox.

types.name: geomData
types.port_note: Pointer-free archive record. worm.bmd's original data relies on model_MakeNode consuming pVertNormals as an eighth child index.

types.name: modelObject
types.port_note: Native node pointers preserve the exact 104-byte x64 PDB layout and compact the runtime-only model record on 32-bit Xbox.

types.name: modelSpace
types.port_note: Native-pointer modelObject/Mnode records preserve exact x64 storage and compact naturally on 32-bit targets.

types.name: TextureTracker
types.port_note: The native material pointer preserves the matched x64 layout and compacts naturally on 32-bit targets.

types.name: Mnode
types.port_note: Native pointers preserve the exact 152-byte x64 PDB layout and intentionally compact the runtime node to 136 bytes on 32-bit Xbox.

types.name: ExtraCharacter
types.port_note: Pointer-free exact PDB record; model_id remains a 32-bit enum on PC and Xbox.

types.name: WorldData
types.port_note: x64 offsets are asserted exactly; native pointers intentionally compact the runtime-only structure on 32-bit Xbox.

types.name: CharacterData
types.port_note: Pointer-free exact PDB record; fixed-width definitions preserve the Windows long fields on PC and Xbox.

types.name: JEDICOMBOMASK
types.port_note: Pointer-free exact PDB record.

types.name: optionstruct
types.port_note: Pointer-free exact PDB record; fixed-width implementation fields preserve the matched Windows ABI for Xbox.

types.name: saveGameStruct
types.port_note: Pointer-free exact PDB record and matched PC Game payload. Fixed-width fields make the raw layout portable without a serialization dependency.

types.name: gamestruct
types.port_note: Pointer-free exact PDB record. Fixed-width fields preserve the matched Windows ABI unchanged for the later 32-bit Xbox build.

types.name: CControl
types.port_note: Pointer-free exact PDB record.

types.name: SControl
types.port_note: Pointer-free exact PDB record.

types.name: SCB
types.port_note: Native pointers preserve the x64 PDB layout and compact the live sprite-control record for 32-bit Xbox.

types.name: EffectData
types.port_note: Pointer-free exact PDB layout is directly reusable by the later 32-bit Xbox build.

types.name: EffectHeader
types.port_note: Uses a fixed-width 32-bit count and pointer-free effect records, preserving the PC asset layout on Xbox.

types.name: RingData
types.port_note: Pointer-free exact PDB ring-effect asset record.

types.name: Ring
types.port_note: Native pointers match the x64 PDB and compact to the asserted 64-byte Xbox layout.

types.name: Sprite
types.port_note: Native pointers preserve the x64 PDB layout; the live runtime Sprite compacts naturally on 32-bit Xbox.
